high_level_description: The image is a humorous and creative comparison between a "normal" artery and a "bodypositive" artery. The illustration is divided into two sections, each depicting the cross-section of an artery. Top Section: Normal Artery The text at the top reads "Artery." The illustration shows a cross-section of a normal artery with a relatively clear lumen (the inner space through which blood flows). There are a few small white dots scattered within the lumen, representing blood cells. The outer layer of the artery is depicted as a pinkish-red color, indicating the arterial wall. 2
